description: Defines the Commit class as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing git commit objects, including commit metadata such as SHA, message, author, and committer information.

classes.name: Commit
classes.description: A DTO class representing a git commit, including metadata such as SHA, message, author, and committer details.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Commit object with repository path and commit SHA.

methods.name: getSha
methods.description: Returns the SHA hash of the commit.

methods.name: getAuthorName
methods.description: Returns the name of the commit author.

methods.name: getAuthorEmail
methods.description: Returns the email of the commit author.

methods.name: getCommitterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the committer.

methods.name: getCommitterEmail
methods.description: Returns the email of the committer.

methods.name: getCreationTime
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the last modification of the commit.
